name: @doubleup/tokens
description: Design tokens (brand, common, component) en Style Dictionary-build voor het DoubleUP Design System.

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-names.mjs && node scripts/check-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs
scripts.generate: for t in $(ls src/themes); do node scripts/generate-palette.mjs $t; done && node scripts/generate-color-roles.mjs
